user.title: Add a Luck Jingle printer
user.description: Scan the label with your phone's camera, then paste the QR contents here. Home Assistant will look up the printer's BLE address while it is powered on and nearby.

error.invalid_pairing_code: Enter the QR contents in name?address format, or a BLE address.
error.printer_not_found: The printer was not found over BLE. Turn it on, move it near Home Assistant, and try again.
